about: Android's carrier ID table as CarrierIdProvider stores it, expanded from the AOSP carrier list (Apache-2.0, the Android Open Source Project). OCD ranks a carrier-ID selector by the weight of the rules behind that ID on the SIM's network (rule round 45, item 3); tools/aosp_carrier_list.py writes this file.
